title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the 'item' column in the DataFrame. Each row represents a fruit item available at a store location.

title: Counting Occurrences
text: To find the item that appears most frequently, you need to count how many times each item appears in the 'item' column.

title: Using value\_counts()
text: Use the value\_counts() method on the 'item' column to count the occurrences of each fruit.

title: Accessing the Most Frequent Item
text: After using value\_counts(), access the first index to get the item that appears the most.
